thread:
anya: quick heads-up — onboarding 'mistral-mini-v2' from partner; weights uploaded to gs://rdw-models/onboard/mistral-mini-v2/weights.tar.gz but the runtime parser is complaining about sentinel/special token ordering. seeing an extra leading <bos> when using the chat template. can someone sanity-check tokenizer + serving config? link to config: /infra/model-configs/mistral-mini-v2.yaml

cheng: I can dig in. can you paste a minimal reproducer (prompt + tokenized ids) and the serving config flags (chat_template, add_bos, etc.)?

anya: sample quick dump — prompt: \"Human: Hello
Assistant:\"
encoded -> [50256, 0, 50257, 1534, 11, 50256]
that 0 looks like an internal sentinel we expect to be removed; but it's appearing before <s>. Running locally with the tokenizer binary returns the same. snippet I used:
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('Human: Hello\\nAssistant:').ids)
```

mira: hmm that ordering smells like bos/eos got flipped between weights metadata and tokenizer.json. our convention is bos=50257, eos=50256. can someone open tokenizer.json -> 'added_tokens' and weights metadata (configs/metadata.json) to verify? I can prepare a small patch to swap mapping in the model wrapper if weights are authoritative.

infra-bot: automated-config-checker: model-configs/mistral-mini-v2.yaml -> FAIL
  reason: tokenizer.special_tokens mismatch with weights metadata (bos/eos reversed).
  details: metadata.bos_id=50256 metadata.eos_id=50257 tokenizer.json maps bos->50257 eos->50256
  resolution: verify weights and tokenizer source, or update model-configs to align.

sam: pushed a draft fix in https://git.internal/redwood/serving/PRs/1345 — aligns tokenizer wrapper mapping with weights metadata and adds unit test for chat template behavior (test_chat_bos_eos_duplicate). PTAL @jules @mira :eyes:

jules: looking — note: the serving runtime also prepends an internal <s> when chat_template=true. if tokenizer itself emits an explicit bos token you get duplication. we should gate in config-validation: if chat_template==true and tokenizer produces an explicit bos for empty-prefix, warn/fail. will comment on the PR. :thinking_face:

mira: agreed. i'll add a validator that compares tokenizer.encode(prefix).ids for common chat prefixes and flags duplicates. also saw a failed fetch earlier: weights checksum mismatch on first download. anya can you confirm latest gs path + checksum?

anya: re-uploaded corrected archive to gs://rdw-models/onboard/mistral-mini-v2/weights_v2.tar.gz
sha256: abc123def4567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890
please pull that one (old path removed). updated model-configs to point to weights_v2.

sam: running CI with PR + new weights. @cheng can you re-run local eval once CI finishes? sample prompt to sanity check: \"Tell me a joke\" (expect single EOS at end, no duplicate signals)

cheng: running local eval now with weights_v2 — quick check shows single eos and no leading sentinel. good on my machine. will run a small sweep across prompt variants.

jules: quick review done, left two tiny nits on the PR (docstring + a flake8 line). functionally LGTM. :shipit:

anya: thanks — merging once CI green and nits addressed. i'll mark onboarding ticket as \"ready for catalog\" and add a short note about the chat-template validator. :tada:
